title: Asobo admits what broke your planes + massive FREE A330 upgrade! (MSFS 2024)
description:
Asobo CEO Sebastian Wloch just owned up to the 6-year-old line of code that broke third-party aircraft in Sim Update 7—and it’s forcing a major overhaul of the Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024 roadmap for 2027. Plus, iniBuilds unveiled a massive FREE upgrade for the default A330, Working Title showed off the Embraer Praetor 600 live, and World Update 24 is finally heading to South Africa.

Skip the 2.5-hour developer livestream—here is every major announcement, release window, and fix you need to know.

💬 Question of the Day: Are you okay with only TWO Sim Updates in 2027 if it means fewer broken planes and better stability? Let me know in the comments!

⏱️ Chapters
00:00 - MSFS 2024 dev stream recap: 6-year bug & 2027 shifts
00:16 - MSFS 2024 Marketplace gifting launches today
00:34 - Sim Update 7 drag bug explained & Sim Update 8 fix
02:03 - Free iniBuilds A330 upgrade: charts, TOD pause & sounds
03:00 - Marker 5
04:02 - World Update 24 South Africa & Paramount Mwari reveal
04:54 - MSFS 2027 roadmap, live weather fix & SU17 news
06:11 - What fewer Sim Updates mean for MSFS in 2027

✈️ Key lightlights from the stream
• Marketplace Gifting: Live today for MSFS 2024’s 2-year anniversary.
• Sim Update 8: Introduces opt-in Normalization V2 to permanently fix the SU7 drag/lift regression without breaking existing aircraft.
• Default A330 Overhaul (iniBuilds): Native Lido & Navigraph charts in the EFB, 2x/4x time compression, auto-pause at TOD, autopilot disconnect protection, overhauled audio, and unmirrored wing textures.
• Working Title Praetor 600: First-principles turbomachinery physics solver + Boris Audio Works soundscape, targeting December 8.
• World Update 24 (Q1 2027): South Africa with 10 photogrammetry areas (Cape Town, Durban, Johannesburg), 44 POIs, 3 handcrafted airports (George, Kruger, King Shaka), and Local Legend 27: Paramount Aerospace Mwari.
• 2027 Roadmap Shift: Scaling back to 2 Sim Updates for stability, alongside 3 World Updates, 3 City Updates, 4 Local Legends, and an unannounced "very big surprise."
• Quick Notes: Livery Update 1 delayed to SU8, live weather cloud-capping under audit, MSFS 2020 SU17 briefly paused, and Stranger Things missions leaving Dec 31 (Bell helicopter stays).
